tools.name: check_trademark
tools.description: Check whether a brand, product or company name is available as a trademark. Searches the USPTO register and scores similar marks by conflict risk. Free, no account needed. Signed-in Arcangel users can set full_report for a full clearance search (US + EU/WIPO, dead marks, domains, common-law). Result

tools.name: get_trademark_check
tools.description: Get the result of a trademark check that was still running. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned.

tools.name: suggest_nice_classes
tools.description: Suggest trademark (Nice) classes for a description of goods or services, e.g. "mobile app for booking yoga classes".

name: start_trademark_application
description: Start a US trademark application on Arcangel AI as a draft in the signed-in user's account. Pass what is known (the mark, goods or services, classes, owner); the rest can be added later with update_trademark_application. Returns the draft id and what it still needs. Requires Sign in with Arcangel. S

name: update_trademark_application
description: Fill in or change fields on a trademark application draft (owner, address, mark details, classes, use dates, statements). Only fields passed are changed. Returns what the draft still needs. Requires Sign in with Arcangel.

name: get_trademark_application
description: Show what a trademark application draft still needs before it can be signed and paid for: missing fields, files to upload (logo, specimens) with upload links, and the link to finish on arcangel.ai.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_trademark_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the result of a trademark check that was still running. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned." → after: "Get the result of a trademark check that was still running, or the next part of a long full report. Pass the search_id that check_trademark returned, and part when the report says it continues."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
